أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَٰنَنِ

parent_channels.name: Measured Cycles and Thresholds

subchannels.name: Dawn Opening Through Night
subchannels.scene_or_process: Night covers the field, movement continues within it, and dawn ruptures the cover as an opening.
subchannels.active_motifs: night-covering `ج ن ن:B002/m01`; night `ل ي ل:B001/m01`; night travel `س ر ي:B001/m01`; dawn `ف ج ر:B002/m01`; opening at dawn `ن ف س:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene is a continuous passage from concealment to disclosure. The latent breath-opening sense of `ن ف س` makes dawn resemble a constricted field releasing into light.

subchannels.name: Watches, Intervals, and Due Time
subchannels.scene_or_process: Time is divided into night watches and intervals until an appointed stage becomes due.
subchannels.active_motifs: night hours `ء ن ي:B002/m01`; interval spacing `و ت ر:B004/m01`; due maturity `ء ن ي:B003/m01`; appointed time `ج م م:B007/m01`; current night `ل ي ل:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: These motifs form a schedule rather than a generic theme of time: intervals partition the night and culminate in a due moment.

subchannels.name: Tens, Fractions, and Recurring Days
subchannels.scene_or_process: A counted whole is organized as ten, a tenth, a batch, an ordinal day, or a recurring festival.
subchannels.active_motifs: ten `ع ش ر:B001/m01`; tenth share `ع ش ر:B003/m01`; batch of ten `ع ش ر:B005/m01`; first or Sunday `ء ح د:B004/m01`; recurring holiday `ع و د:B007/m01`; tenth-day observance `ع ش ر:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Counting becomes calendrical organization. The same lexical field moves from cardinal quantity to fractional share, ordinal day, and periodically returning observance.

subchannels.name: Pair, Odd, and the Unpaired Individual
subchannels.scene_or_process: Units are joined into pairs while an odd remainder or solitary individual remains unpaired.
subchannels.active_motifs: joining into a pair `ش ف ع:B001/m01`; odd remainder `و ت ر:B001/m01`; individual unit `ء ح د:B005/m01`; singular isolation `ي ت م:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The direct pair-and-odd contrast expands into a social and numerical scene of joining versus solitary remainder.

subchannels.name: Endpoint and Culmination
subchannels.scene_or_process: Motion or duration reaches an endpoint at the moment when completion is due.
subchannels.active_motifs: endpoint `ء ل ي:B001/m01`; due completion `ء ن ي:B003/m01`; appointed time `ج م م:B007/m01`; completed year `د ك ك:B007/m01`; terminal limit `ق د ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene links direction, timing, and measure: an approach terminates when its allotted span has matured.

subchannels.name: Lunar Stations and Night Orientation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Recurrent celestial shapes mark stations by which night can be divided and traversed.
subchannels.active_motifs: lunar mansion `ب ل د:B004/m01`; ostrich-like lunar station `ن ع م:B007/m02`; moon halo `ح ج ر:B006/m02`; night `ل ي ل:B001/m01`; forward guide `م ل ك:B008/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Shape analogy turns a lunar station, halo, and forward guide into a practical night-orientation scene.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A continuum becomes intelligible when it is opened, counted, paired, or brought to a due boundary.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 89:1-5 anchors dawn, ten nights, pair and odd, night passage, and oath.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The temporal sequence extends into calendars, scheduled watches, ordinal days, and lunar wayfinding.

parent_channels.name: Assembly, Alignment, and Dispersal

subchannels.name: Filling, Gathering, and Heaping
subchannels.scene_or_process: Material or people accumulate until a container, place, or heap is full.
subchannels.active_motifs: filling abundance `ج م م:B001/m01`; gathering `ل م م:B001/m01`; aggregation `ك ث ر:B007/m01`; gathered pile `ص ب ب:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The motifs describe one scalar process from individual additions to a full mass or visible heap.

subchannels.name: Rows and Dense Assemblies
subchannels.scene_or_process: A multitude is organized into rows at a common place.
subchannels.active_motifs: ordered rows `ص ف ف:B001/m01`; crowded assembly `د ك ك:B008/m01`; large group `ر ب ب:B004/m01`; mass of people `ج ن ن:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Density does not remain amorphous: the crowd is sorted into aligned collective presence.

subchannels.name: Commingling and the Interloper
subchannels.scene_or_process: Distinct materials or social elements are mixed, with an inserted outsider becoming part of the compound.
subchannels.active_motifs: commingled mixture `ب ل ل:B009/m01`; mixing action `س و ط:B001/m01`; inserted insider or interloper `د خ ل:B005/m01`; likeness within the blend `م ث ل:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: A physical blend and a social mixture share the same role map: heterogeneous elements, insertion, and a resulting composite.

subchannels.name: Fragmentation and Scattering
subchannels.scene_or_process: A gathered whole breaks into portions that move away in different directions.
subchannels.active_motifs: scattering `ب ل و:B009/m01`; dispersal `ب ل ي:B008/m01`; branching separation `ع ب د:B010/m01`; dissipating division `ص ب ب:B007/m01`; shards or portions `ع ش ر:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene proceeds from fracture to directional spread; the shard sense supplies the concrete unit produced by division.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Separate units change state by collecting, aligning, mixing, or scattering.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 89:3, 89:19-22 supply pair/odd, gathered consumption, abundance, repeated crushing, and rows.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same transformations organize crowds, heaps, social mixtures, shards, and branching routes.

parent_channels.name: Shaped Ground and Built Supports

subchannels.name: Cutting Rock Into a Valley Place
subchannels.scene_or_process: Hard stone is pierced or excavated within a valley to create usable space.
subchannels.active_motifs: piercing or excavation `ج و ب:B001/m01`; hard stone `ح ج ر:B003/m01`; boulder `ص خ ر:B001/m01`; valley `و د ي:B005/m01`; water-holding rock hollow `خ ل ق:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Tool-like cutting acts on resistant material in a valley setting, producing a hollow that can become chamber or reservoir.

subchannels.name: Crushing and Leveling the Ground
subchannels.scene_or_process: Raised or resistant terrain is pounded down into a low, even surface.
subchannels.active_motifs: crushing and leveling `د ك ك:B001/m01`; flat low ground `د ك ك:B002/m01`; earth `ء ر ض:B001/m01`; adhesion to ground `ب ل د:B010/m01`; bare level surface `ص ف ف:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Repeated impact changes relief into a stable plane. The adhesion motif marks the outcome as contact with, rather than elevation above, the ground.

subchannels.name: Columns, Pegs, and Reinforcement
subchannels.scene_or_process: Upright members are fixed and interlocked to carry or stabilize a structure.
subchannels.active_motifs: column `ع م د:B003/m01`; peg `و ت د:B001/m01`; supporting shaft `س ر ي:B005/m01`; structural cohesion `م ل ك:B001/m01`; reinforcement `و ث ق:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene combines vertical support, anchoring, and cohesion. Binding is the mechanism that turns separate members into a durable frame.

subchannels.name: Precinct, Chamber, and Protected Interior
subchannels.scene_or_process: A boundary encloses an interior and regulates who or what may enter.
subchannels.active_motifs: enclosure or chamber `ح ج ر:B004/m01`; town or bounded land `ب ل د:B001/m01`; concealed garden `ج ن ن:B003/m01`; hiding place `ج ن ن:B017/m01`; restriction at the boundary `ح ج ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Boundary, interior, and controlled access make a single precinct scene, with the garden as a protected cultivated interior.

subchannels.name: Channel, Dam, and Reservoir
subchannels.scene_or_process: A valley channel is constricted by a dam so water gathers in a basin.
subchannels.active_motifs: descending channel `ص ب ب:B002/m01`; valley center `م ل ك:B006/m01`; valley `و د ي:B005/m01`; dam `ع م د:B013/m01`; basin `ج ي ء:B002/m01`; rock reservoir `خ ل ق:B011/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Slope conducts water, the dam interrupts it, and the hollow receives it. This is a complete hydraulic mechanism rather than a loose water cluster.

subchannels.name: Smoothing, Paving, and Finishing
subchannels.scene_or_process: A rough surface is worked until it is even, traversable, or polished.
subchannels.active_motifs: smooth formed surface `خ ل ق:B008/m01`; level finish `ص ف ف:B005/m01`; paved or treated way `ع ب د:B005/m01`; persistent finishing motion `ص ب ب:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Formation continues beyond gross construction into finishing: repeated work removes irregularity and makes a surface usable.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Stable places are made by cutting, leveling, bounding, supporting, and directing material.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 89:7-10 and 89:21-22 foreground columns, carved rock, valley, pegs, leveled earth, and rows.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Monumental construction extends into dams, reservoirs, polished surfaces, bodily marks, and load-bearing joints.

parent_channels.name: Water Moving Into Life

subchannels.name: Rain Returning Life to Soil
subchannels.scene_or_process: Rain arrives, revives soil, and establishes fresh pasture.
subchannels.active_motifs: life-giving rain `ح ي ي:B002/m01`; rain as provision `ر ز ق:B003/m01`; returning water `ر ج ع:B006/m01`; first rain and pasture `ر ص د:B004/m01`; good rain and fertile soil `ك ر م:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Arrival, return, revived ground, and pasture form a causal ecological sequence from weather to renewed life.

subchannels.name: Spring, Pour, and Surface Bubbles
subchannels.scene_or_process: Water breaks out, pours forward, fills, and visibly bubbles at the surface.
subchannels.active_motifs: water-burst `ف ج ر:B001/m01`; pouring `ص ب ب:B001/m01`; water bubbles `ح ب ب:B008/m01`; filling water `ج م م:B001/m01`; opening or release `ن ف س:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The same rupture that names dawn also yields a concrete spring scene: release, flow, accumulation, and surface agitation.

subchannels.name: Torrent and Overflow
subchannels.scene_or_process: Accumulating water exceeds its bounds and becomes an overwhelming flood.
subchannels.active_motifs: flood excess `ط غ و:B002/m01`; flood surge `ط غ ي:B002/m01`; abundant gathered water `ر ب ب:B013/m01`; fullness `ج م م:B001/m01`; poured mass `ص ب ب:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Quantity becomes force when containment fails. This hydraulic transformation provides a concrete counterpart to moral transgression.

subchannels.name: Sweet Water, Drinking, and Watering Cycles
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sweet water is drawn, drunk, and returned to livestock on a regular watering schedule.
subchannels.active_motifs: sweet potable water `ع ذ ب:B001/m01`; drinking or filling `ح ب ب:B006/m01`; leading animals to drink again `د خ ل:B007/m01`; watering interval `ع ش ر:B006/m01`; draught `ن ف س:B006/m01`; survival water `م ل ك:B007/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene has source, consumer, herd movement, and recurrence. Water is both drink and the resource that makes stopping in a place possible.

subchannels.name: Vegetation and Garden Growth
subchannels.scene_or_process: Moist fertile ground produces dense vegetation and a cultivated garden.
subchannels.active_motifs: fertile soil `ء ر ض:B002/m01`; dense vegetation `ج ن ن:B011/m01`; cultivated plant `ر ب ب:B012/m01`; gathered growth `ج م م:B005/m01`; plant among rocks `ص خ ر:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Soil, plant, density, and bounded garden form one growth scene, including vegetation that occupies otherwise hard terrain.

subchannels.name: Seed, Fruit, and Ripening
subchannels.scene_or_process: Seed becomes crop, fruit matures, and a vine or palm yields edible produce.
subchannels.active_motifs: seed `ح ب ب:B001/m01`; crop yield `ء ك ل:B002/m01`; ripening `ط ع م:B005/m01`; vine or grape `ك ر م:B004/m01`; palm pith `ك ث ر:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The motifs trace a complete agricultural transformation from kernel through ripeness to harvestable fruit.

subchannels.name: Sap, Extract, and Medicinal Paste
subchannels.scene_or_process: Plant material is pressed into juice or resin and thickened into a bitter medicinal preparation.
subchannels.active_motifs: bitter drug or gum `ح ض ض:B003/m01`; plant extract `ص ب ب:B006/m01`; thick syrup `ر ب ب:B006/m01`; medicinal dressing `ر ب ب:B006/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Extraction and thickening connect vegetation to treatment: liquid sap becomes a prepared paste applied as medicine.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Water changes location and form while enabling fertility, nourishment, and habitation.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 89:1, 89:9, 89:13, and 89:16-18 anchor bursting, valley, pouring, provision, and food.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The hydrologic sequence extends into bubbles, pasture, livestock schedules, fruit ripening, sap, and medicinal extracts.

parent_channels.name: Food, Preparation, and Containment

subchannels.name: Eating, Taste, and Palatability
subchannels.scene_or_process: Food is apportioned, tasted, and consumed according to its sweetness or suitability.
subchannels.active_motifs: eating `ء ك ل:B001/m01`; tasting or eating `ط ع م:B001/m01`; food provision `ر ز ق:B002/m01`; sweet food or water `ع ذ ب:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Consumption is grounded in an edible object, sensory evaluation, and allotted provision rather than in appetite alone.

subchannels.name: Roasting, Pot, and Stew
subchannels.scene_or_process: Meat or plant food is cut into strips, roasted, and cooked in a pot or liquid stew.
subchannels.active_motifs: roasted strips `ص ف ف:B003/m01`; cooking pot `ق د ر:B007/m01`; vessel `ء ك ل:B013/m01`; date stew `س و ط:B004/m01`; thick cooking base `ر ب ب:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: A vessel receives prepared strips and liquid ingredients, yielding a single culinary process from cutting to cooked mixture.

subchannels.name: Jar, Bowl, Basket, and Lid
subchannels.scene_or_process: A rigid or woven container receives material and is closed or covered.
subchannels.active_motifs: jar `ح ب ب:B007/m01`; vessel or bowl `ء ن ي:B004/m01`; pottery vessel `ص خ ر:B002/m01`; palm basket `د خ ل:B010/m01`; lid `ك ر م:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Container body, material, woven alternative, and lid form a compact artifact scene centered on storage.

subchannels.name: Hunting, Carcass, and Edible Meat
subchannels.scene_or_process: An animal is hunted or selected, fattened, cut, and made edible.
subchannels.active_motifs: hunting implement `ط ع م:B006/m01`; prey or fattened animal `ء ك ل:B007/m01`; breeding animal `ح ج ر:B007/m01`; animal fatness `ط ع م:B007/m01`; meat or haunch `ء ل ي:B015/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Tool, animal, body portion, and edible outcome make this a hunting-and-butchery scene distinct from cooking in a vessel.

subchannels.name: Abstention and the Withheld Mouthful
subchannels.scene_or_process: Eating or drinking is deliberately prevented, producing deprivation or disciplined abstention.
subchannels.active_motifs: abstaining from food or drink `ع ذ ب:B002/m01`; prevention or weaning `ع ذ ب:B003/m01`; throat grip `ط ع م:B012/m01`; restraint `ح ج ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene reverses nourishment: access is blocked at the boundary of consumption, either as discipline, weaning, or coercive deprivation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Edible material becomes usable through tasting, cutting, cooking, and containment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 89:18-19 foreground feeding, food, and eating.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The food scene expands into roasting strips, date stew, lidded jars, hunting tools, and ascetic abstention.

parent_channels.name: Animal Bodies, Herds, and Habitats

subchannels.scene_or_process: Livestock gather as a herd, remain near pasture, and supply subsistence.

parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 89:2, 89:8-9, 89:15, and 89:18 provide counting, land, valley, favor, and feeding anchors.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The network reaches ostrich nests, returning birds, milk pails, serpents, a small wild ox, and termite damage.

parent_channels.name: Body as Cavity, Surface, and Joint

subchannels.name: Face, Pupil, and Double Vision

parent_channels.surprising_reach: Architectural and astronomical forms recur as chest, skull, pupil, nostril, hip socket, and sexual anatomy.

parent_channels.name: Generation, Kinship, and Care

subchannels.name: Living Creature, Soul, and Breath
subchannels.scene_or_process: A living body is animated by breath and understood as a soul or enduring self.

subchannels.synthesis: Physiology and personhood meet in a single animation scene: breath sustains the creature while soul names its living identity.

subchannels.name: Womb, Fetus, Birth, and Afterbirth
subchannels.scene_or_process: A fetus remains concealed in the womb, emerges in childbirth, and is followed by afterbirth.
subchannels.active_motifs: fetus `ج ن ن:B007/m01`; womb or reproductive organ `ح ي ي:B011/m01`; childbirth `ن ف س:B005/m01`; womb and afterbirth `ع ذ ب:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Concealment, maternal organ, emergence, and postpartum material form a complete birth process.

subchannels.name: Pregnancy, Gestation, and Failed Return
subchannels.scene_or_process: Pregnancy becomes visible, advances through a long term, and may end in live birth or failed gestation.
subchannels.active_motifs: visible pregnancy `ر ء ي:B010/m01`; pregnant animal `ش ف ع:B004/m01`; ten-month gestation `ع ش ر:B007/m01`; recent birth or ewe `ر ب ب:B009/m01`; failed pregnancy `ر ج ع:B013/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Visibility, duration, maternal animal, and outcome distinguish gestation from the separate scene of birth itself.

subchannels.name: Marriage, Consummation, and Marital Return
subchannels.scene_or_process: A marriage contract permits entry and consummation, while separation may be reversed by marital return.
subchannels.active_motifs: consummation `د خ ل:B002/m01`; marriage contract `م ل ك:B004/m01`; marital return `ر ج ع:B004/m01`; woman without spouse `ي ت م:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Contract, sexual entry, separation status, and return form one legal and domestic marriage frame.

subchannels.name: Fosterage, Orphanhood, and Lap Protection

parent_channels.name: Provision, Property, and Redistribution

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Goods acquire moral and social meaning through allotment, withholding, transfer, and use.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 89:15-20 contrasts provision and restriction with orphan care, feeding, inheritance, and love of wealth.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The same economy includes pay, tithe, revenue, gifts for return, preemption, and compensation for loss.

parent_channels.name: Character and Public Standing

subchannels.name: Habit, Method, and Imitation

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Inner disposition becomes socially legible through conduct, generosity, reputation, imitation, or corruption.

parent_channels.surprising_reach: Character is carried by face, rumor, habitual pace, counterfeit action, and rivalry in giving.

parent_channels.name: Perception, Thought, and Memory

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Information moves from sensory detection through inner judgment into retained guidance.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 89:5-6, 89:14, and 89:23-24 foreground intellect, seeing, watching, remembering, and regretful speech.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The channel includes diplopia, the evil eye, divided planning, inner speech, madness, and legal memory.

parent_channels.name: Speech, Logic, and Reference

subchannels.name: Question, How, and Whence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A speaker seeks identity, manner, source, or possibility through an interrogative.

subchannels.synthesis: Content, organ, articulation quality, and social mention form one speech-production scene.

subchannels.name: Rumor and Circulating Report

subchannels.name: Definition, Description, and Essence

subchannels.synthesis: Sign, boundary, description, and essence form a coherent semantic-definition operation.

subchannels.synthesis: The motifs form clause architecture: correction reopens the proposition, pronoun identifies a referent, and preposition or object assigns relation.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Language connects speaker, proposition, answer, and referent through distinct discourse operations.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 89:5-6, 89:15-16, and 89:23-24 contain questions, assertions, and reported speech.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The discourse system extends into corrective particles, pronouns, definitions, rumor, and phonetic articulation.

parent_channels.name: Covenant, Restraint, and Reparation

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A relation becomes durable when it is sworn, trusted, physically secured, or repaired after breach.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 89:5 gives oath, while 89:26 gives binding.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Binding extends from testimony and truce to marriage, surety, fetter, and blood compensation.

parent_channels.name: Rule, Transgression, and Judgment

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Power establishes order, exceeds its bounds, watches for response, and imposes sanction.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 89:6-14 and 89:25-26 present lords, rulers, transgression, corruption, punishment, surveillance, and unique binding.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Political authority resonates with ownership, bodily mastery, idol allegiance, exemplary punishment, and prepared traps.

parent_channels.name: Belonging, Lineage, and Social Boundary

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Groups maintain identity by descent, shared residence, collective presence, naming, and controlled inclusion.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 89:6-11 names peoples, places, lands, and monumental group identities.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Lineage extends into crowds, tent households, intimate insiders, strangers, mountains, and personal names.

parent_channels.name: Human and Unseen Agency

subchannels.name: Approach and Confrontation
subchannels.scene_or_process: An agent advances toward another, arrives, and may compel an encounter.
subchannels.active_motifs: confrontation `ء ر ض:B007/m01`; coming `ج ي ء:B001/m01`; compelled arrival `ج ي ء:B005/m01`; advance `ق د م:B004/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Direction, moving agent, target, arrival, and coercive outcome form a complete encounter scene.

subchannels.name: Return and Homecoming
subchannels.scene_or_process: A traveler reverses course and reaches a familiar return-place.
subchannels.active_motifs: return `ر ج ع:B001/m01`; return `ع و د:B001/m01`; return-place `ع و د:B002/m01`; homecoming from travel `ق د م:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The same-root returns converge on route reversal, destination, and completed arrival.

subchannels.name: Convalescence and Visiting the Sick
subchannels.scene_or_process: Illness gives way to recovery, supported by return visits and renewed function.
subchannels.active_motifs: recovery `ب ل ل:B003/m01`; recovery after illness `ر ج ع:B014/m01`; restored condition `م ث ل:B012/m01`; visiting the sick `ع و د:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Patient state, recuperative change, visitor, and restored outcome make a coherent convalescence scene.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Movement is shaped by waiting, pace, fatigue, approach, reversal, and recovery.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 89:4, 89:22-24, and 89:28-30 provide night travel, coming, advancing, return, and entry.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Motion extends into animal gait, slack bowstrings, delayed maturity, visiting the sick, and convalescence.

parent_channels.name: Residence, Refuge, and Tranquility

subchannels.name: Settlement and Sustained Residence
subchannels.scene_or_process: A resident remains in a suitable place because shelter and sustenance remove the need to depart.
subchannels.active_motifs: residing `ب ل د:B009/m01`; staying `ر ب ب:B007/m01`; residence `س ك ن:B002/m01`; suitable dwelling `ن ع م:B011/m01`; sustaining pasture `س ك ن:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Place, inhabitant, continued stay, and local provision form a stable settlement scene.

subchannels.name: Shelter, Bedding, and Concealed Refuge
subchannels.scene_or_process: A person withdraws into a concealed place furnished for rest.
subchannels.active_motifs: hiding place `ج ن ن:B017/m01`; chamber `ح ج ر:B004/m01`; bedding or coverlet `م ث ل:B007/m01`; thick rug `ء ر ض:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Boundary, hidden interior, floor covering, and resting surface produce a complete refuge scene.

subchannels.name: Stillness, Comfort, and Trust
subchannels.scene_or_process: Movement ceases as the resident becomes calm, comfortable, and assured.
subchannels.active_motifs: stillness `س ك ن:B001/m01`; comfort `س ك ن:B004/m01`; tranquility `ط م ء ن:B001/m01`; calm `ط م ن:B001/m01`; trust `و ث ق:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The scene traces an embodied transition from motion to repose and then to relational assurance.

subchannels.name: Entry Into Home
subchannels.scene_or_process: A returning participant crosses a boundary and joins an inhabited interior.
subchannels.active_motifs: entry `د خ ل:B001/m01`; dwelling `س ك ن:B002/m01`; return-place `ع و د:B002/m01`; intimate belonging `ء ن س:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Approach, threshold crossing, interior, and recognized membership form a domestic entry scene.

subchannels.name: The Tranquil Soul's Final Entry
subchannels.scene_or_process: The tranquil soul returns accepted, joins the servants, and enters the garden.
subchannels.active_motifs: soul `ن ف س:B011/m01`; tranquility `ط م ن:B001/m01`; return `ر ج ع:B001/m01`; mutual acceptance `ر ض و:B003/m01`; entry `د خ ل:B001/m01`; worshiping servants `ع ب د:B003/m01`; garden `ج ن ن:B003/m01`
subchannels.ayah_anchors: 89:27-30 (النفس المطمئنة، ارجعي، راضية مرضية، ادخلي في عبادي، ادخلي جنتي)
subchannels.synthesis: State, summons, movement, reciprocal approval, community, and destination form the surah's most complete belonging scene.

subchannels.name: Burial as Final Lodging
subchannels.scene_or_process: A body is placed beneath earth in a grave and concealed as in a final dwelling.
subchannels.active_motifs: burial `ج ن ن:B009/m01`; burying with earth `د ك ك:B003/m01`; grave-place `ب ل د:B001/m02`; lap-like enclosure `ح ج ر:B005/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Excavated place, body, earthen covering, and concealment make burial a terminal residence scene.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: A place becomes home when it affords stable entry, concealment, nourishment, and calm.
parent_channels.surface_relation: direct; 89:27-30 moves from tranquility and return to entry among servants and into the garden.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Secure belonging extends into bedding, pasture-fixed residence, ship stabilization, and burial as final lodging.

parent_channels.name: Crafted Instruments and Material Assemblies

subchannels.name: Wood, Stick, and Adze
subchannels.scene_or_process: Timber is cut or carved with an adze and fashioned into a stick, bat, or support.
subchannels.active_motifs: wood or stick `ع و د:B010/m01`; bat or stick `ق و ل:B008/m01`; adze `ق د م:B008/m01`; cutting `ج و ب:B001/m01`; column `ع م د:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Material, cutting tool, shaping action, and finished implements form a woodworking scene.

subchannels.name: Whip, Strap, and Knife
subchannels.scene_or_process: A handled instrument carries a flexible lash or cutting edge and leaves a mark on the body.
subchannels.active_motifs: whip `س و ط:B002/m01`; hanging whip-tip or strap `ع ذ ب:B006/m01`; knife `س ك ن:B007/m01`; bodily mark `ب ل د:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Handle, flexible extension or blade, action on flesh, and resulting mark form one instrument-of-injury scene.

subchannels.name: Bowstring, Peg, and Training Target
subchannels.scene_or_process: A string is tensioned between fixed points and aimed at a circular target.
subchannels.active_motifs: bowstring `و ت ر:B007/m01`; fixed peg `و ت د:B001/m01`; circular training mark `و ت ر:B008/m01`; circular eye-like mark `ح ج ر:B006/m03`; hunting implement `ط ع م:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Anchor, tension, projectile function, and target complete an archery and marksmanship mechanism.

subchannels.name: Shield and Armor
subchannels.scene_or_process: A shaped covering receives impact while protecting the body behind it.
subchannels.active_motifs: shield `ج ن ن:B008/m01`; shield or protective clothing `ج و ب:B005/m01`; smooth unprojecting surface `ج م م:B006/m01`; binding firmness `و ث ق:B002/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Covering, body, impact-facing surface, and reinforcement form a defensive artifact scene.

subchannels.name: Rudder and Stabilized Vessel
subchannels.scene_or_process: A rudder at the stern controls a vessel and dampens its oscillation.
subchannels.active_motifs: ship rudder `س ك ن:B008/m01`; calming control `ط م ن:B001/m01`; compelled direction `ج ي ء:B005/m01`; firm reliance `و ث ق:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Vessel, steering component, controlling action, and stabilized outcome form a complete navigational mechanism.

subchannels.name: Linen, Damp Folding, and Tanning
subchannels.scene_or_process: Cloth or hide is dampened, folded into pleats, treated by measured application, and allowed to wear.
subchannels.active_motifs: linen `ر ز ق:B007/m01`; damp folding `ب ل ل:B007/m01`; first fold or pleat `ق س م:B007/m01`; tanning dose `ن ف س:B007/m01`; wear of material `خ ل ق:B009/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Material, moisture, repeated fold, measured treatment, and aging outcome form a textile-and-hide preparation scene.

subchannels.name: Gaming Arrows, Lot, and Container
subchannels.scene_or_process: Marked arrows or lots are stored together, drawn, and used to allocate an outcome.
subchannels.active_motifs: arrow-lot container `ر ب ب:B010/m01`; gambling lot `ن ف س:B016/m01`; palm basket `د خ ل:B010/m01`; draw from a quiver `ر ج ع:B010/m01`; odd or single result `و ت ر:B001/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Container, marked pieces, random draw, and allocated result form a complete gaming-lot mechanism.

subchannels.name: Necklace, Incense, and Perfume Preparation
subchannels.scene_or_process: Aromatic wood is ground or prepared while beads are joined into a worn ornament.
subchannels.active_motifs: necklace `ك ر م:B003/m01`; aromatic wood `ء ل ي:B014/m01`; incense wood `ع و د:B010/m02`; perfume `خ ل ق:B010/m01`; perfume mortar `ع ب د:B012/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: The branch paths join two workshop products through material preparation: aromatic substance is ground, while ornament components are assembled for wear.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Raw material is shaped, joined, tensioned, or folded into a tool with a specific function.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 89:7, 89:9-10, 89:13, 89:22, and 89:26 anchor supports, cutting, pegs, whip, alignment, and binding.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: The artifact system includes adzes, bowstrings, training targets, shields, rudders, linen pleats, gambling kits, necklaces, and incense.

parent_channels.name: Damage, Decay, and Repair

subchannels.name: Wear, Fraying, and Corrosion
subchannels.scene_or_process: Repeated use thins a surface until fibers fray and material is consumed.
subchannels.active_motifs: wear `ب ل و:B001/m01`; wear `ب ل ي:B001/m01`; worn surface `خ ل ق:B009/m01`; corrosion `ء ك ل:B006/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Use, abrasion, thinning, and material loss form a single decay process across cloth, hide, and hard surface.

subchannels.name: Termite Gnawing Through Wood
subchannels.scene_or_process: A termite enters timber and consumes it until the structure is hollowed or eradicated.
subchannels.active_motifs: termite `ء ر ض:B010/m01`; corrosion or gnawing `ء ك ل:B006/m01`; total consumption `ء ر م:B006/m01`; wood `ع و د:B010/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Agent, material, repeated gnawing, and structural loss make a specific biological decay scene.

subchannels.name: Fire, Sparks, and Rekindled Embers
subchannels.scene_or_process: Sparks ignite material, fire consumes it, and buried embers can be stirred back into flame.
subchannels.active_motifs: fire consuming `ء ك ل:B005/m01`; sparks `ح ب ب:B011/m01`; stirring inherited embers `و ر ث:B005/m01`; burial or covering `د ك ك:B003/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Ignition, consumption, concealment, and rekindling form a cyclical fire process.

subchannels.name: Wound, Pus, and Suppuration
subchannels.scene_or_process: A wound or sore collects pus, opens, and discharges infected material.
subchannels.active_motifs: festering sore `ء ر ض:B011/m01`; pus `ج ي ء:B003/m01`; suppurating wound `ج ي ء:B006/m01`; aperture `ج و ب:B004/m01`; blood or discharge `ص ب ب:B006/m02`
subchannels.synthesis: Lesion, collected material, opening, and discharge form a complete pathology scene.

subchannels.name: Nurture, Treatment, and Restoration
subchannels.scene_or_process: A damaged body or object is treated, repaired, and returned to sound condition.
subchannels.active_motifs: repair and nurture `ر ب ب:B002/m01`; medicinal preparation `ر ب ب:B006/m02`; recovery `ب ل ل:B003/m01`; restoration `م ث ل:B012/m01`; return to health `ر ج ع:B014/m01`
subchannels.synthesis: Care, remedy, patient or object, and restored outcome reverse the deterioration scenes without collapsing into them.

parent_channels.semantic_invariant: Bodies and materials deteriorate through wear, consumption, heat, or infection and may be restored through treatment.
parent_channels.surface_relation: indirect; 89:12-13, 89:21, and 89:28 anchor corruption, punishment, earth, and return.
parent_channels.surprising_reach: Moral corruption has concrete counterparts in frayed cloth, termite-eaten wood, rekindled embers, pus, and convalescent repair.

parent_channels.name: S1. Raised Cairn as Marker
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Stones are raised and joined into a visible cairn that marks a place or route.
parent_channels.active_motifs: stone marker `ء ر م:B002/m01`; boulder `ص خ ر:B001/m01`; raised joined summit `ء ر م:B001/m01`; visible standard `ر ء ي:B011/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Material, stacking action, elevation, and visual function form a complete landmark scene.

parent_channels.name: S2. Banner and Vanguard
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A visible banner precedes a moving group and provides orientation.
parent_channels.active_motifs: banner `ر ء ي:B011/m01`; foremost guide `م ل ك:B008/m02`; vanguard `ق د م:B007/m01`; elevated support `ع م د:B005/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Signal, bearer, forward position, and following group define a scene of guided collective movement.

parent_channels.name: S3. Echo, Clang, and Counted Bray
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A sharp sound strikes a hard surface, reverberates, and may be recognized or counted by repeated calls.
parent_channels.active_motifs: echo `ر ج ع:B007/m01`; metal or stone clang `ص خ ر:B004/m01`; nightingale-like sound `ب ل ل:B010/m01`; counted brays `ع ش ر:B008/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Sound source, hard resonator, return wave, and repeated count form a coherent acoustic scene.

parent_channels.name: S4. Sudden Collective Eruption
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A dense crowd or event breaks out suddenly with overwhelming noise.
parent_channels.active_motifs: sudden mass event `ف ج ر:B003/m01`; crowd `د ك ك:B008/m01`; overwhelming noise `ط غ و:B008/m01`; gathering `ص ف ف:B007/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Sudden onset, dense participants, clamor, and collective assembly define an eruption scene distinct from gradual gathering.

parent_channels.name: S5. False Accusation and Surrender of a Person
parent_channels.scene_or_process: A false claim is circulated and used to hand a person over to another party.
parent_channels.active_motifs: allegation or handing over a person `ء ك ل:B010/m01`; false attribution `ق و ل:B005/m01`; rumor `ق و ل:B007/m01`; compelled presentation `ج ي ء:B004/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Accusation, verbal fabrication, circulation, and delivery of the accused form a specific coercive discourse scene.

parent_channels.name: S6. Pounding in a Mortar
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Material is placed in a mortar and repeatedly pounded into a usable preparation.
parent_channels.active_motifs: mortar `ه و ن:B004/m01`; pounding `د ك ك:B001/m01`; vessel `ء ن ي:B004/m01`; medicinal paste `ر ب ب:B006/m02`
parent_channels.synthesis: Container, material, repeated impact, and processed outcome define a compact preparation mechanism.

parent_channels.name: S7. Returned Waste and Reuse
parent_channels.scene_or_process: Discarded material returns from a prior use or bodily process and is gathered for reuse or disposal.
parent_channels.active_motifs: returned waste or material `ر ج ع:B015/m01`; hidden residue or defect `د خ ل:B004/m01`; gathered remainder `ص ب ب:B003/m01`
parent_channels.synthesis: Residue, return path, and collection form a small but complete recovery-of-material scene.
